title: Architecture Invariant Audit — F-CI27 Restart Recomposition
scope: exact two-file qualified restart recomposition on current F-CI27 canonical source

invariants.01_single_calculation_kernel: PASS_UNCHANGED; restart restores the existing canonical committed state and adds no alternate physics kernel.
invariants.02_kernel_separate_from_IO: PASS; restart records remain serialization-neutral and introduce no file/path/parser dependency into the kernel.
invariants.03_explicit_data_separation: PASS; committed physical continuation, runtime identity, parameter references and provenance remain distinct.
invariants.04_compact_persistent_state: PASS_IN_SCOPE; continuation records exclude immutable parameter payloads and solver scratch.
invariants.05_scratch_per_worker: PASS; worker/Newton/Jacobian/warm-start data are absent from restart records.
invariants.06_scalable_memory_layout: PASS_NOT_REQUALIFIED_GLOBALLY; registry-based many-column restore remains intact and no heavy per-column solver ownership is added.
invariants.07_transactional_timesteps: PASS_IN_SCOPE; only committed-boundary state is exported/restored and publication is atomic after complete validation.
invariants.08_cheap_recompute_and_warm_start: PASS_UNCHANGED; restored committed state is a valid recomputation base; no trial state is promoted.
invariants.09_generic_time: PASS_IN_SCOPE; non-calendar time window 5100.125 -> 5100.4375 -> 5100.8125 and exact continuation pass.
invariants.10_flexible_coupling_windows: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; no midnight/day-window assumption is introduced.
invariants.11_coupling_core_functionality: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; transactional committed-state semantics are preserved without claiming a coupling qualification.
invariants.12_explicit_groundwater_interface_contra: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; no head/flux interface semantics are changed.
invariants.13_absolute_mass_conservation: PASS_IN_SCOPE; exact interval mass continuation and continuous-vs-restarted endpoint identity pass.
invariants.14_interface_sensitivities_first_class: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; no tangent/Jacobian output contract changes.
invariants.15_limit_coupling_cost: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; restart adds no normal-path repeated physics solves.
invariants.16_multiswap_primary_use_case: PASS_IN_SCOPE; restart is exercised for 1,2,7,8,17,31,32 logical columns.
invariants.17_no_required_one_to_one_MODFLOW_relati: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; restart records logical column identity only.
invariants.18_deep_vadose_optional_external_compone: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; no transfer-zone state or routing is introduced.
invariants.19_mass_conserving_component_transition: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; no component transition is added; committed water-state identity is retained.
invariants.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers_open: PASS_IN_SCOPE; restart admission is explicit by backend/state family and unknown families fail closed.
invariants.21_maximum_SWAP_physics_reuse: PASS_UNCHANGED; no physical process implementation is duplicated.
invariants.22_no_other_modules_coupled_to_HeadCalc_: PASS; restart uses committed-state/runtime contracts rather than HeadCalc internal arrays.
invariants.23_physics_options_separate_from_solver_: PASS; template/layout/state-family checks remain explicit and no numerical policy changes physics.
invariants.24_predictable_runtime: PASS_BOUNDED_IN_SCOPE; validation is finite and fail-closed before whole-registry publication; no fallback policy is altered.
invariants.25_reference_mode_available: PASS_UNCHANGED; reference runtime remains present and is the tested real-physics backend.
invariants.26_runtime_diagnostics: PASS_NOT_MODIFIED; existing runtime diagnostics are preserved; restart does not remove retry/mass/mode information.
invariants.27_optional_functionality_scales_with_us: PASS_IN_SCOPE; only explicitly admitted state families carry restart continuation state.
invariants.28_runtime_coupler_organizes_system_comp: PASS; restart registry/template composition stays outside the kernel and contains no tile/MODFLOW mapping.
invariants.29_no_silent_dependencies: PASS; state family, template/layout, parameter identity, lineage/revision/time and target freshness are explicit/fail-closed.
invariants.30_every_architecture_change_explicitly_: PASS; exact source locks, O0/O2 matrix, negative attacks, mass/identity checks and F-CI27 ET preservation are recorded.

scope_boundaries: restricted serialized real-physics MultiSWAP restart only
MODFLOW/coupling correctness is not newly qualified
canonical admission requires independent F-CI governance
